evidence.excerpt: Tijana Fejsa received her Bachelor's and Master's degrees in Mechatronics Engineering from the Faculty of Technical Sciences, University of Novi Sad, in 2005 and 2007 respectively, and her PhD from the same institution in 2013 with a dissertation on fault-coverage optimisation in boundary-scan test architectures for mixed-signal assemblies. She joined the Department of Mechatronics, Robotics and Automation as a Teaching Assistant in 2008 and was promoted to Associate Professor in 2021. Her group focuses on automated test system design, in-circuit and boundary-scan test coverage analysis, and fault-detection algorithm development for printed circuit board assemblies subjected to thermal cycling and accelerated ageing. She teaches courses on embedded systems testing, measurement systems, and industrial automation. The group operates a PCB test laboratory equipped with JTAG boundary-scan controllers, flying-probe testers, thermal cycling chambers, and a mixed-signal oscilloscope suite.
